title: Relativistic Quantum Theory Extended to the Universe - the New Constant Hx and How it Contributes to the Sun’s Charge
content: Where are the Large-Scale limits of quantum mechanics?. The term "large-scale" offers a very wide range of possibilities. Space (the size scale) has no immanent (intristic) scale. The most important interpretation of quantum mechanics, the relativistic Dirac equation as well, has no scale. The interpretation of the present publication, following Dirac's guidance, shows the universe from a new perspective with the help of quantum mechanics.
